# VICE

> Independent digital media company covering global youth culture, news, music, and lifestyle through investigative journalism and creative storytelling.

VICE produces original content spanning news, documentaries, and cultural commentary, with specialized projects like city guides and advocacy campaigns. Known for covering underrepresented stories and emerging cultural movements across music, nightlife, travel, and social issues.

## Key Topics

- Youth culture and counterculture
- Investigative journalism
- Music industry and live venues
- Urban exploration and city guides
- COVID-19 impact on culture
- UK nightlife and club culture
- European travel destinations
- Local curation and discovery
- Independent music venues
- Food and drink culture
- Arts and entertainment advocacy
- Renaissance Hotels partnerships
- Boris Johnson era UK politics
- Artists: Foals, Arlo Parks

## Travel & City Guides

- [Navigator](https://navigator.vice.com/): VICE & Renaissance Hotels city guide for six European destinations including Paris, featuring local curation, food, drink, and nightlife recommendations

## Music & Culture Advocacy

- [Fund Our Fun](https://fundourfun.vice.com/): Interactive map highlighting struggling UK clubs and music venues during COVID-19 lockdowns, documenting the crisis facing live music and nightlife culture
